title: Kickoff-hour weather FORECAST for upcoming non-dome home games (Open-Meteo forecast) + climatology fallback beyond the horizon
description: Prediction-time source for the adopted weather_wind family (game model reads `games` only) and for build_weekly's weather factor (reads `games` then `climatology`). Keyless forecast data, rebuilt each run; open + retractable venues (retractable stays neutral in build_weekly). `games` rows are the kickoff-hour forecast inside the 16-day horizon, stamped source=forecast + fetched_utc; `climatology` rows (R56) are the home stadium's mean kickoff-hour temp/wind for the game's calendar month over 2021-2025 from weather_history.json, only where n >= 4 games (fewer -> no row), stamped source=climatology with the measured `rules` the row may fire (docs/WEATHER_HORIZON.md). Naturally small in-week and empty in the offseason (dormant). Never a model input on its own - applied only when weather_wind has cleared NEVER-REGRESS.

games.description: "season|week|HOME|AWAY" -> kickoff-hour forecast. `source`/`fetched_utc` are stamped by the R56 builder; a pre-R56 file carries neither and reads as forecast rows.

climatology.description: "season|week|HOME|AWAY" -> stadium-month climatology for a scheduled non-dome home game with no forecast row. Absent for a pre-R56 file.

temp_c.description: Mean kickoff-hour temperature (C) over the stadium-month's games in weather_history.json.

wind_kph.description: Mean kickoff-hour wind (km/h) over the same games.

n.description: Games behind the mean; the builder writes no row below 4.

month.description: Calendar month (UTC kickoff) the mean describes.

rules.description: Threshold rules build_weekly may fire from this row. A rule that fires at the mean but was wrong for more than half of the stadium-month's 2023-2025 games (or has no measured games) is withheld.

absent.description: Scheduled non-dome home games with neither row: beyond the horizon and no stadium-month with n >= 4. Absent is absent.
